metrics.description: Identifies instances where a variable is used in a calculation or output statement, measuring the accuracy of data transformations and ensuring variable values correctly influence final results.
metrics.derivation: c_use = len([d for d in definitions if d.user_count > 0])
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: C-Use Coverage % = (Computational DU Pairs Exercised / Total C-Use Pairs) × 100

python.derivation: c_use = len([d for d in definitions if d.user_count > 0])

metrics.description: Identifies where a variable is used to determine the outcome of a decision, measuring how data values control the program execution flow and ensuring both True and False outcomes are tested.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: P-Use Coverage % = (Predicate DU Pairs Exercised / Total P-Use Pairs) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: >= 65% of predicate use pairs exercised (True + False outcomes)

metrics.description: Links every definition of a variable to all possible locations where that specific value could be read, creating a map of data influence across the function to ensure no use-case is left untested.
metrics.derivation: def_use_pairs = sum(d.user_count for d in definitions)
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: DU Pair Map Coverage % = (Identified and Mapped DU Pairs / Total Estimated DU Pairs) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: >= 90% of DU pairs identified and mapped in analysis
metrics.normalization_formula: Score = DU Pair Map Coverage % [gate at 90%]

python.derivation: def_use_pairs = sum(d.user_count for d in definitions)

metrics.description: Confirms that every single identified Definition-Use pair (both c-use and p-use) has been executed at least once, measuring the total thoroughness of the test suite regarding data integrity.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Full DU Verification % = (DU Pairs with both C-Use and P-Use tested / Total DU Pairs) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: >= 65% of DU pairs fully verified for both use types

metrics.description: Highlights specific variable uses that have never been reached during testing, helping developers find blind spots where a variable is defined but its impact on a calculation or branch is unverified.
metrics.derivation: partial_uses = len([d for d in definitions if d.user_count == 0]) + len(missing_lines)
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Gap Score = (DU Pairs with no test exercise / Total DU Pairs) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: < 35% of DU pairs untested (65% coverage floor)

python.derivation: partial_uses = len([d for d in definitions if d.user_count == 0]) + len(missing_lines)

metrics.description: Tracks variables that are redefined multiple times such as inside a loop or multiple if blocks, measuring the complexity of the data lifecycle to ensure the current value is always the intended one.
metrics.derivation: multiple_definitions = len([d for d in definitions if d.user_count > 1])
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Redefinition Coverage % = (Redefined Variables with all active definitions tested / Total Redefined Variables) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: >= 80% of redefined variables tested across all definition states

python.derivation: multiple_definitions = len([d for d in definitions if d.user_count > 1])

metrics.description: Identifies code blocks that attempt to use a variable but can never be executed due to logical constraints, helping clean up technical debt by removing logic that relies on impossible data states.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Ghost Use % = (Uses that can never be reached / Total Declared Uses) × 100

metrics.description: Provides a detailed report showing which data paths are safe and which are risky, ensuring your MVP meets high-quality standards by providing an audit trail for every variable in the system.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Report Completeness % = (DU pairs with full audit record / Total DU Pairs) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: >= 90% of DU pairs have complete data integrity audit record

metrics.description: % of definition-use pairs (variable defined, then used in computation or predicate) exercised by tests
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: All-Uses Coverage % = (Covered DU Pairs / Total DU Pairs) × 100
